name_original: BenQ - 27" LED HD FreeSync Monitor - Black/Red
description_original: This BenQ XL2730Z 27" LED FreeSync monitor provides crisp, clear graphics in 2560 x 1440 resolution for a full high-definition picture. An ultrafast 1 ms response time minimizes blurring during fast-paced games, so you can stay a step ahead of the competition.
description_official_dataset: BENQ 27" LED HD FreeSync Monitor: 1 ms gray-to-gray response time; 1000:1 contrast ratio; 350 nits brightness; 2560 x 1440 resolution; DVI-DL, HDMI 2.0, HDMI 1.4, DisplayPort 1.2 and VGA (D-Sub) inputs; antiglare screen; headphone/microphone jack; 144Hz refresh rate
